scripts.text:
[Killer]
Wh-what have
you done to me?!
C-can't... move!
scripts.translation:
[杀手]
你...你对我做了什么？！
我...动不了！

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Oh? I didn't expect
you to be able to cast
Close Confine so soon!
Amazing, just amazing!
Now, this is a good chance
for you to master the skill...
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
哦？这么快就使出了紧密的约束！
了不起！
正好借此机会，把这招彻底练熟...

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Now pay attention.
I want you to practice
predicting your opponent's
movement intent on this killer.
You should be able to see which way he plans to move by his aura.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
看好了，就拿这杀手练习，预判他下一步的动作。
观察他身上的气息，就能看出想往哪儿走。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
If he plans to move to left,
his aura will be white. If he
moves to the right, it will be
yellow. If he intends to go
backward, it will be pale red.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
想向左，气息就是白色；向右，便是黄色；想后退，则是淡红色。

scripts.text: Block him to the Left
scripts.translation: 向左拦截

scripts.text: Block him to the Right
scripts.translation: 向右拦截

scripts.text: Block his Retreat
scripts.translation: 封住退路

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe killer remains
unable to move and looks
incredibly confused! Right
now, you're using the Close
Confine skill perfectly!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF杀手仍动弹不得，一脸茫然！
此刻，你已将紧密的约束运用得恰到好处！^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait--!
For some reason,
you sense that's not
the direction the killer
is moving at this moment.
You naturally correct yourself.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等等——！
不知为何，你感觉到杀手此刻并没有朝那个方向移动。
你本能地修正了自己的判断。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou successfully
retrieved the priceless
skill book written by the
legendary Chae Takbae.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你成功取回了传奇人物蔡德培所写的珍贵技能书。^000000

scripts.text:
[Killer]
Grrrrr...
S-still...
C-can't... Move!
scripts.translation:
[杀手]
Grrrrr...
还、还是...动、不了！

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Hm? Ah, amnesia as
resulting from transcending,
eh? Then I will teach you the
Close Confine skill once again.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
嗯？转生后失忆了？
那我再教你一遍紧密的约束。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
A Stalker, eh?
Make sure that you
use your abilities to
malign foes that deserve
to be stalked. Best of
luck to you, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
神行太保啊。
好好运用本领，对付那些罪有应得的敌人。
冒险者，祝你顺利。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
H-how did you find this
place? I thought this panic
room was supposed to be
impenetrable, even by Rogues!
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
你...你是怎么找到这个地方的？
我以为这个密室连流氓都进不来！

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
This can't be good!
It will only be a matter of
time before they find me...
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
这下糟了！
他们迟早会找到我的...

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Wh-who are you,
and how did you get
in here? Identify yourself!
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
你、你是谁，怎么进来的？
报上名来！

scripts.text: I don't mean you any harm!
scripts.translation: 我没有恶意

scripts.text: Give us what we want!
scripts.translation: 交出我们要的东西

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
No...?
Then... Then
why have you come?
It is no accident that
you have found me.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
没有恶意？
那么...那你为什么来这里？
你能找到我，绝非偶然。

scripts.text: I came to help you.
scripts.translation: 我是来帮你的

scripts.text: Oh, actually, I wasn't looking for you.
scripts.translation: 其实，我并不是在找你

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Hmm... Well, I suppose
I can trust a fellow Stalker
with my predictament. Honor
among thieves and all that.
Alright. Have you ever heard
the legend of Chae Takbae?
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
嗯...同为神行太保，这困境也许可以告诉你。
盗亦有道嘛。
听过蔡德培的传说吗？

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Hmm... Well, I suppose
I can trust a fellow Rogue
with my predictament. Honor
among thieves and all that.
Alright. Have you ever heard
the legend of Chae Takbae?
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
嗯...同为流氓，这困境也许可以告诉你。
盗亦有道嘛。
听过蔡德培的传说吗？

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
100 years ago, Chae Takbae
was the very first person to
transcend his limits. He was
also the very person to choose
a different path, rather than the job order he previously had.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
100年前，蔡德培是首位突破极限、完成转生的人。
他也是首位不再沿着原先的职业路线走，而选择另一条道路的人。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
He was originally a Monk,
but after transcending, he
somehow became a Stalker.
Retaining his knowledge of
the Monk's Root skill, he adapted it for the purposes of the Rogues.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
他原本是武僧，转生后却不知为何成了神行太保。
他还记得武僧的真剑百破道，于是加以改良，成了流氓可用的招式。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Chae Takbae recorded the
fundamentals for this new
Rogue skill in a book that
I was fortunate enough to
obtain. But as soon as I got
it, the blackmailing begain...
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
蔡德培将这项流氓新技能的要诀写进书中，我有幸得到了它。
可书一到手，勒索也跟着来了...

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
There are unscrupulous
parties that will use any
means to take the book away
from me. I can understand, as
my sons and I have learned new
skills from Takbae's writings.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
有些人不择手段，要从我这里夺走书。
也不难理解，毕竟我和儿子们已从德培的书里学到了新本领。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
However, I am running
out of time and those men
will inevitably find me.
Will you help me save
myself and my sons?
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
可时间不多了，那些人迟早会找到我。
你愿意帮我，救救我们父子吗？

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 当然

scripts.text: Sorry, but I'm busy.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我很忙

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Oh, thank you so much!
Listen, I can't risk being
found, so would you take
this letter to my youngest
son, ^FF0000Louis Greg^000000? Hurry,
there's not much time left!
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
多谢！
我不能冒险露面，拜托把这封信交给小儿子^FF0000路易斯·格雷格^000000。
快，没多少时间了！

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
I... I see.
But please realize
that, if not you, who
can I trust to help me?
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
我...明白。
可是，除了你，我还能信谁、找谁来帮忙呢？

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Then you would know the
value of the skill book he has
written that I now possess.
However, I'm hounded by men
who will do anything to get it.
Would you please help me?
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
那你就该知道，我手中这本技能书有多珍贵。
可有人为得到它，一直穷追不舍。
帮帮我，好吗？

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 当然

scripts.text: Sorry, but I'm busy.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我很忙

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Oh, thank you so much!
Listen, I can't risk being
found, so would you take
this letter to my youngest
son, ^FF0000Louis Greg^000000? Hurry,
there's not much time left!
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
多谢！
我不能冒险露面，拜托把这封信交给小儿子^FF0000路易斯·格雷格^000000。
快，没多少时间了！

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
I... I see.
But please realize
that, if not you, who
can I trust to help me?
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
我...明白。
可是，除了你，我还能信谁、找谁来帮忙呢？

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Hm...?
That seems unlikely, but
I suppose I better give you
the benefit of the doubt.
Well then, I hope that you
can find your way out of here.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
嗯...？
这似乎不太可能，但我想我还是应该给你一点信任。
那么，我希望你能找到出路离开这里。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
I see. So be it.
I'll show you the skill
that you covet so much...
^FF0000Close Confine^000000!
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
明白了，那就让你见识见识，心心念念的这招...
^FF0000紧密的约束^000000！

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Hmpf. Now you are
helpless, allowing
me to do this: ^FF0000Back Stab^000000!
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
哼，动不了吧？
那我就不客气了：^FF0000背刺^000000！

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Now get out of here.
Never show your greedy
face in front of me again.
And just be happy that
I haven't killed you!
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
滚出去！
别再让我看见你这副贪婪嘴脸。
没杀了你，就该庆幸！

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
We're running out of
time... Please bring this
letter to my youngest son,
^FF0000Louis^000000, as soon as you can!
You can find him in the Rogue
Guild near ^FF0000Hollgrehenn Junior^000000.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
没时间了...快把信送给小儿子^FF0000路易斯^000000！
他在流氓公会里，^FF0000小霍尔格雷恩^000000附近。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Louis sent you to find
^FF0000Thor^000000? He's in the Rogue
Guild near ^FF0000Hermanthorn Jr.^000000,
isn't he? I'm sorry that you
have to visit my sons one by
one... I know it's impractical.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
路易斯让你找^FF0000索尔^000000？
他在公会里，^FF0000小赫曼索恩^000000附近吧？
抱歉，害你一个个找我儿子，实在麻烦...

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Ah, looking for ^FF0000Jay^000000, eh?
He's near ^FF0000Antonio Jr.^000000 here
in the Rogue Guild. Or at
least, he's usually there.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
找^FF0000杰伊^000000？
他通常在公会里的^FF0000小安东尼奥^000000附近。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Oh, you're back!
And you've brought
a letter from Jay.
Good, good, let me
read what he has to say...
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
回来了！
还带了杰伊的信，好，看看他说什么...

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Ah, great news! He's
contacted the Rogue Guild
to request extra protection
and to alert their guard. I can
finally relax just a little now. No one messes with Rogues.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
太好了！
他已向流氓公会求援，请他们加强保护、提高戒备。
这下能稍微放心了，谁敢惹流氓呢。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Thank you very much for
your help. I would be in
hiding forever if it weren't
for you. In return, let me
offer you the chance to learn
Chae Takbae's secret skill.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
多亏你帮忙，不然我怕是得一直躲下去。
为表谢意，给你个机会，学习蔡德培的秘技。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Please speak to ^FF0000Thor^000000
and tell him that I've
permitted you to learn
the skill I have taught
all of my sons. He'll
comply, I'm sure of it.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
去找^FF0000索尔^000000，说我准许你学习传给儿子们的招式。
他一定会答应。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Please ask Thor to teach
you Chae Takbae's secret
Rogue skill. Understand that
I can't teach you this skill
with the equipment here in
this sloven panic room.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
请索尔教你蔡德培的流氓秘技吧。
这避难密室乱糟糟的，器材也不够，我没法在这儿教。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Hm...? Aren't you
supposed to be in the
middle of training to learn
that skill? Please speak to
Thor and complete your training.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
嗯？你不是该在训练吗？
去找索尔，把练习完成吧。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
You've completed the
training? Ah, that's quite
exceptional. However, you
should speak to Thor first...
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
训练完成了？
不错，不过先去找索尔...

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Oh, you've come back!
I hear that you've completed
the training and are ready
to hear about the applications
for the Close Confine skill.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
回来了啊！
听说训练已完成，可以进一步学习紧密的约束的用法了。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Wah! What th--?!
Stop! P-please, stop
that man! We can't let
him steal that book!
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
哇，什么？！
快、快拦住他！
不能让他偷走那本书！

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
That man just stole the
Close Confine skill book!
Please! Don't let him get
away! That book is priceless!
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
那人偷了紧密的约束技能书！
别让他跑了，书可是无价之宝！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou returned the
skill book written by
Chae Takbae to Haijara.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你将蔡德培写的技能书归还给了海哈拉。^000000

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Thanks so much for your
assistance. Now, if you'd
like to know some detailed
information about Close
Confine, I can tell you more
about the skill if you like.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
多谢相助。
想再了解紧密的约束的细节，我可以讲给你听。

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 请讲

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
As you must know,
Close Confine immobilizes
an enemy that is very close
to you. However, there are
a few nuances regarding its
use on players or monsters.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
紧密的约束能困住身旁的敌人，让其无法移动。
不过，对玩家和魔物使用，有些细节不同。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Now, Close Confine is
similar to the Monk's skill,
Root, but it only inhibits the
enemy's movement, not
its attack capabilities.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
它类似武僧的真剑百破道，却只限制移动，并不阻止敌人攻击。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
With the exception of
Back Stab, which we can
only use once during Close
Confine's duration, we can
use any skill during the
Close Confine status.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
约束持续期间，各种技能都能照常使用，唯有背刺，只能用一次。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Enemies affected by
Close Confine can escape
by using Fly Wing, Butterfly
Wings, or the Teleport or
Hiding skills. However, only
Hiding is active during WoE.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
被困住的敌人，可用苍蝇翅膀、蝴蝶翅膀，或瞬间移动、隐匿逃脱。
不过，攻城战时，这些办法里只有隐匿管用。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Therefore, Close Confine
can be a very useful skill
during Guild War sieges, given
that the target doesn't use the
the Hiding skill to get away.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
所以攻城战时，只要对手不用隐匿脱身，紧密的约束就很实用。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
With the exception of Boss
monsters, Close Confine
will immobilize monsters for
10 seconds, giving Rogues
new possibilities when
hunting in a party.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
除首领魔物外，一般魔物都会被困住10秒，让流氓组队狩猎时有更多战术可用。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Well, that's all I can tell
you about Close Confine.
I hope that you can learn
more about this skill through
practice, and that you become as great a legend as Chae Takbae.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
关于紧密的约束，能讲的就这些。
余下靠实践领悟吧，愿你也成为蔡德培那样的传奇。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
All right then...
I hope that you can
learn more about Close
Confine through diligent
practice. Good luck, and
thanks again for your help.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
好，那就勤加练习，继续钻研紧密的约束吧。
祝你顺利，也再次谢谢相助。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Thank you for helping
me protect this priceless
skill book. I hope that the
next time we meet, we'll be
comrades on the battlefield...
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
谢谢你保住这本无价的技能书。
愿下次再见，我们能在战场上并肩作战...

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
H-how did you find this
place? I thought this panic
room was supposed to be
impenetrable, even by Rogues!
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
你...你是怎么找到这个地方的？
我以为这个密室连流氓都进不来！

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
This can't be good!
It will only be a matter of
time before they find me...
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
这下糟了！
他们迟早会找到我的...

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Please...
Find me a Stalker
or a Rogue that I can
trust and send him to
help me! I don't have 
much time left...
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
拜托...找个值得信任的神行太保或流氓，让他来帮我！
没多少时间了...

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
My father just...
He just vanished!
He was teaching me and
my brothers a new skill,
but lately he began acting
paranoid for some reason...
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
父亲...突然就不见了！
原本还在教我们兄弟新技能，可最近不知怎么，总疑神疑鬼的...

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
Maybe he went into hiding?
I know there's a hidden panic
room in the Rogue Guild, but
even I don't know where to find
it. I hope everything's okay...
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
也许藏起来了？
听说公会里有个秘密避难室，连我也找不到。
但愿他平安...

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
Father did warn that
people might come after us
if they're learned about the
new skill we were learning.
Maybe he went into hiding in
the Rogue Guild's panic room...
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
父亲警告过，一旦别人知道我们学的新技能，可能就会找上门来。
也许他躲进公会的避难密室了...

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
What's this...?
A letter from my
father? Oh, he must
be alright! Quick, let
me read it right away!
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
这是...父亲的信？
太好了，他应该没事！
快给我看看！

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
Oh no, he may be safe for
now, but father is being hunted
by some dangerous people? My
brother Thor will want to know
about this. Let me write him
a letter really quickly...
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
糟了，虽说暂时平安，父亲却在被危险人物追杀？
得让哥哥索尔知道，我赶紧写封信...

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
I know that I'm in no
position to ask any favors,
but I guess my father must
trust you. Please, would you
take my letter and deliver it
to my older brother, Thor?
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
本不该再麻烦你，不过，父亲一定很信任你。
拜托，把这封信交给我哥哥索尔，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
You can find Thor
next to Hermanthorn Jr.
inside the Rogue Guild.
I'd really appreciate it if
you could help my family.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
索尔在流氓公会，小赫曼索恩旁边。
能帮帮我们家，实在感激不尽。

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
My elder brother, ^FF0000Thor^000000,
must know about this right
away! Please bring him this
letter for me. He should be
near ^FF0000Hermanthorn Jr.^000000 here
inside the Rogue Guild.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
哥哥^FF0000索尔^000000必须立刻知道！
拜托把信交给他，他在公会里的^FF0000小赫曼索恩^000000附近。

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
You're looking for my
brother, Jay? He's usually
hanging out here in the
Rogue Guild with Antonio Jr.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
你在找我哥哥杰伊？
他通常都在流氓公会里，和小安东尼奥混在一起。

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
If you need to speak
to my father, he's still
probably in the hidden panic
room inside the Rogue Guild.
I still don't know where that
place could possibly be...
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
要找父亲的话，大概还在公会的避难密室里。
到现在，我也不知道那地方究竟在哪儿...

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
You want to learn the
secret Rogue skill? Oh,
you should probably talk
to ^FF0000Thor^000000 about that. I...
I'm really bad at explaining
things to people. Really bad.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
想学流氓秘技？
那还是找^FF0000索尔^000000吧，我...实在不擅长教人，真的。

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
Hm? You're in the middle
of learning the secret Rogue
skill, aren't you? Ooh, then
you're not supposed to be here
just yet. Please go back and
talk to ^FF0000Thor^000000 again, okay?
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
你还在学秘技吧？
现在不该在这里，先回去找^FF0000索尔^000000，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
Oh, oh!
You're done with
the training? Ah,
then you need to
talk to Thor again!
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
哦，训练结束了？
那还得再去找索尔！

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
You wanted to learn
more about Close Confine?
Ugh, then you better speak
to my father. I just learned
that skill myself, you know.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
想再了解紧密的约束？
找我父亲吧，我自己也才刚学会。

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
I just heard from my
brothers that Chae Takbae
developed Close Confine
as a way to brutally beat his
enemies, keeping them from
running away. Is that true?
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
听哥哥们说，蔡德培创出紧密的约束，就是为把敌人困住，狠狠打一顿。
真是这样？

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
Wow, you're really
great! I wish I were
as powerful as you.
I hate being a kid!
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
哇，真厉害！
要是我也这么强就好了，真讨厌当小孩！

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
Why'd I become a Rogue?
I guess I just like being
sneaky. That, and being
moral and law abiding is
just too tough, you know?
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
为什么当流氓？
就是喜欢偷偷摸摸呗，再说，做个守规矩的好人也太难了，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
Where did father go?
I hope those weird men
didn't get to him. With
any luck, he's hidden in
the panic room, but still...
scripts.translation:
[索尔·格雷格]
父亲去哪了？
但愿那些怪人没抓住他。
若他已躲进密室就好了，可还是...

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
Hm... My father might
be hiding in the panic
room. I've never been able
to find it, but Markie says
that the entrance is cleverly
hidden to her left. Hmmm...
scripts.translation:
[索尔·格雷格]
嗯...父亲可能藏在避难密室。
我一直找不到，可马基说，入口巧妙地藏在她左边。
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
Are you looking for
my little brother, ^FF0000Louis^000000?
Oh, he's always hanging
around that ^FF0000Hollgrehenn Jr.^000000
here in the Rogue Guild.
What did you need him for?
scripts.translation:
[索尔·格雷格]
找弟弟^FF0000路易斯^000000？
他老在公会里，跟^FF0000小霍尔格雷恩^000000待一块儿。
找他做什么？

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
What's this you're
giving me? A letter
from Louis? Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[索尔·格雷格]
你给我的这是什么？
路易斯的信件？让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
Oh God, father's in
serious trouble! I better
tell my older brother, Jay,
right away! Quick, find ^FF0000Jay^000000
next to ^FF0000Antonio Jr.^000000 here in
the guild! P-please hurry!
scripts.translation:
[索尔·格雷格]
天哪，父亲遇上大麻烦了！
得赶紧通知大哥杰伊！
去公会里找^FF0000杰伊^000000，就在^FF0000小安东尼奥^000000旁边，快、快去！

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
You can find Jay hanging
out with Antonio Jr. here
inside the Rogue Guild. 
Please bring him the letter
I've written as soon as possible!
scripts.translation:
[索尔·格雷格]
杰伊在流氓公会里，和小安东尼奥待在一起。
快把我写的信交给他！

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
Hopefully, father hasn't
gone outside of the Rogue
Guild's panic room. That
may be the only place
where he's safe...
scripts.translation:
[索尔·格雷格]
希望父亲没有离开流氓公会的密室。
那里可能是他唯一安全的地方...

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
What's that? Father
wanted me to teach you
the secret Rogue skill?
Alright, I'll train you in the
same way father did. Would
you like an explanation first?
scripts.translation:
[索尔·格雷格]
父亲让我教你秘技？
好，就按他教我的办法来训练。
要先听说明吗？

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
If you don't want an
explanation, I'll just
send you to the training
ground right away so that
you can learn ^FF0000Close Confine^000000.
scripts.translation:
[索尔·格雷格]
不想听，就直接送你去训练场，学习^FF0000紧密的约束^000000。

scripts.text: Listen to Explanation
scripts.translation: 听说明

scripts.text: Go to Training Ground
scripts.translation: 去训练场

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
Alright, the very first step
to learning ^FF0000Close Confine^000000
is to master blocking your
enemy's movement. I'll send
you to a special training
ground so you can practice.
scripts.translation:
[索尔·格雷格]
学^FF0000紧密的约束^000000，第一步是学会封住敌人的移动。
我送你去专门的训练场练习。

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
There, you'll encounter our
training partner. Approach her
closely and make sure that you
predict and block her movements
to the left, right or backward. Get ready, I'm sending you now...
scripts.translation:
[索尔·格雷格]
那里有位陪练。
靠近她，预判她会向左、向右，还是后退，再拦住去路。
准备好，现在送你过去...

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
Alright, I'm going to break
the fourth wall here and assume
you were disconnected from the
game. Would you like to return
to the training ground in order
to learn ^FF0000Close Confine^000000?
scripts.translation:
[索尔·格雷格]
好，先跳出故事说句，你刚才大概掉线了吧。
要回训练场，继续学^FF0000紧密的约束^000000吗？

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 回训练场

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
Alright, the very first step
to learning ^FF0000Close Confine^000000
is to master blocking your
enemy's movement. I'll send
you to a special training
ground so you can practice.
scripts.translation:
[索尔·格雷格]
学^FF0000紧密的约束^000000，第一步是学会封住敌人的移动。
我送你去专门的训练场练习。

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
There, you'll encounter our
training partner. Approach her
closely and make sure that you
predict and block her movements
to the left, right or backward. Get ready, I'm sending you now...
scripts.translation:
[索尔·格雷格]
那里有位陪练。
靠近她，预判她会向左、向右，还是后退，再拦住去路。
准备好，现在送你过去...

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
Alright, alright.
When you feel ready
to resume training,
just let me know.
scripts.translation:
[索尔·格雷格]
好，准备好继续训练，再来告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
Ah, I hear from Kienna
that you've completed your
training. Congratulations!
Now, please speak to my
father so that he can explain the Close Confine skill in detail.
scripts.translation:
[索尔·格雷格]
基恩娜说，你完成训练了，恭喜！
去找父亲吧，他会细讲紧密的约束的用法。

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
Please talk to my father
so that he can explain the
nuances of the Close Confine
skill to you. He should still be in the Rogue Guild's panic room.
scripts.translation:
[索尔·格雷格]
去找父亲，了解紧密的约束的细节吧。
他应该还在公会的避难密室里。

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
You know, Chae Takbae
would say, ''I'm Chae
Takbae. And you are...?''
to opponents, and right
before they could answer,
he'd beat them to a pulp.
scripts.translation:
[索尔·格雷格]
听说蔡德培跟人动手前，总问：“我是蔡德培，你是...？”
不等对方回答，就把人揍得稀烂。

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
He really is
a legendary hero
amongst Rogues...!
scripts.translation:
[索尔·格雷格]
他真的是流氓中的传奇英雄...！

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
Hm...?
It seems that
you're much stronger
than even me. There's
probably not too many
people who'd mess with you...
scripts.translation:
[索尔·格雷格]
嗯...？
看来你比我强多了。
大概没多少人敢招惹你...

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
Hmm, gank this, gank
that. *Sigh* It's my most
shameful fault: I spend zeny
almost as quickly as I can
steal it. It's irresponsible...
scripts.translation:
[索尔·格雷格]
嗯，偷这个，抢那个。
*叹气*说来惭愧，偷多少，几乎就花多少，一点都不懂节制...

scripts.text:
[Jay Greg]
My father must be hidden
in the Rogue Guild's panic
room. Strangely, my brothers
and I can never find it and
figure out whether he's safe...
scripts.translation:
[杰伊·格雷格]
父亲肯定躲在公会的避难密室里。
偏偏我们兄弟谁也找不到，连他是否安全都弄不清...

scripts.text:
[Jay Greg]
Recently, he's been pursued
by these strange men who've
been threatening our family.
Well, he did just teach us
a new skill, so he can use
that to protect himself...
scripts.translation:
[杰伊·格雷格]
最近有些怪人追着他不放，还威胁我们全家。
不过，他才教过我们新技能，应该能靠它自保...

scripts.text:
[Jay Greg]
I'm guessing my father
hid himself in the Rogue
Guild's panic room. We can
never find it, but supposedly
the entrance is hidden close
to Markie somewhere.
scripts.translation:
[杰伊·格雷格]
我猜父亲藏在公会的避难密室里。
我们都找不到，据说入口就在马基附近。

scripts.text:
[Jay Greg]
You're looking for
Louis, my little brother?
He's here in the Rouge Guild,
so it shouldn't be too hard to
find him. He's probably just
standing near Hollgrehen Jr.
scripts.translation:
[杰伊·格雷格]
你在找我弟弟路易斯？
他就在流氓公会里，应该不难找到。
他大概正站在小霍尔格雷恩附近。

scripts.text:
[Jay Greg]
Thor? He should be
around the Rogue Guild
somewhere. Have you tried
looking around Hermathorn Jr.?
scripts.translation:
[杰伊·格雷格]
索尔？应该就在公会里。
小赫曼索恩附近找过了吗？

scripts.text:
[Jay Greg]
A letter for me...?
Ah, it's from Thor, so
I guess I better read
it right away. Hmmm...
scripts.translation:
[杰伊·格雷格]
给我的信...？
哦，索尔写的，得马上看看。
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Jay Greg]
I see... I must report
this to the Rogue Guild
right away, and send a reply
to my father. Hmm. Let me
write him a letter right now.
Please give me a moment...
scripts.translation:
[杰伊·格雷格]
明白了...得立刻报告流氓公会，还要回信给父亲。
稍等，我这就写...

scripts.text:
[Jay Greg]
There, it's done. Please
give this to my father with
all the haste you can muster.
I know it's much to ask, but
I cannot find the way to the
hidden panic room myself...
scripts.translation:
[杰伊·格雷格]
写好了，请尽快交给父亲。
又得麻烦你，可我自己实在找不到去密室的路...

scripts.text:
[Jay Greg]
Please give my reply
to my father as soon as
you can. He's still hidden
in the Rogue Guild's panic
room. That is, if our enemies
still haven't found him yet.
scripts.translation:
[杰伊·格雷格]
请尽快把回信交给父亲。
如果敌人还没找到，他应该仍藏在公会的避难密室里。

scripts.text:
[Jay Greg]
You need to train for
the Close Confine skill?
I think Thor is the only
one with access to the
training ground, so
talk to him first.
scripts.translation:
[杰伊·格雷格]
要练紧密的约束？
只有索尔能安排进入训练场，先找他吧。

scripts.text:
[Jay Greg]
You need to train for
the Close Confine skill?
I think Thor is the only
one with access to the
training ground, so
talk to him first.
scripts.translation:
[杰伊·格雷格]
要练紧密的约束？
只有索尔能安排进入训练场，先找他吧。

scripts.text:
[Jay Greg]
Ah, you finished the
training for Close Confine,
did you? Great, now go and
tell my brother, Thor.
scripts.translation:
[杰伊·格雷格]
紧密的约束练好了？
很好，去告诉我弟弟索尔。

scripts.text:
[Jay Greg]
Hm. You should probably
talk to my father to learn
more of the nuances about
the Close Confine skill.
Have you seen him in the
Rogue Guild's panic room?
scripts.translation:
[杰伊·格雷格]
想深入了解紧密的约束，还是问父亲吧。
在公会的避难密室里见过他了吗？

scripts.text:
[Jay Greg]
Chae Takbae sure
seemed like a stubborn,
thuggish guy. But he must
have been pretty smart to
invent some of his own skills.
scripts.translation:
[杰伊·格雷格]
蔡德培看着是个固执又粗暴的家伙，可既然能自创招式，脑子一定好使。

scripts.text:
[Jay Greg]
I get the feeling
that you're going to
be one of the best Rogues
around, if you already aren't.
scripts.translation:
[杰伊·格雷格]
你早晚会成为最出色的流氓之一，说不定现在就是了。

scripts.text:
[Jay Greg]
Ever since I learned
Intimdate, I've gotten
real punchy, maybe even
masochistic. I mean, if they
hit you with a skill, you can
hit them back with it!
scripts.translation:
[杰伊·格雷格]
自从学了抄袭，我就爱打架，没准还真有点爱挨打。
毕竟别人拿技能打你，就能照样还回去啊！

scripts.text:
[Kienna]
Alright, in this
exercise, you'll need
to predict which way I'm
going to move and block
me from moving, essentially
immobilizing me. Get ready~
scripts.translation:
[基恩娜]
练习时，先猜准我会往哪儿走，再挡住去路，让我动弹不得。
准备好~

scripts.text: Block her to the Left
scripts.translation: 向左阻挡

scripts.text: Block her to the Right
scripts.translation: 向右阻挡

scripts.text: Block her retreat
scripts.translation: 封住退路

scripts.text:
[Kienna]
Huh...?
You blocked me!
Very nice work~
scripts.translation:
[基恩娜]
咦...？被你拦住了！
干得漂亮~

scripts.text:
[Kienna]
Sorry, but I wasn't
moving in that direction.
Your block attempt failed...
scripts.translation:
[基恩娜]
抱歉，我可没往那边走。
这次没拦住...

scripts.text:
[Kienna]
Alright, we're done
here. You earned a
scripts.translation:
[基恩娜]
好，训练结束，你的成绩是

scripts.text:
[Kienna]
Alright, we're done
here. You earned a
training grade of ''^0000FFS^000000.''
That's a perfect score!
scripts.translation:
[基恩娜]
好，训练结束，成绩是^0000FFS^000000。
满分！

scripts.text:
[Kienna]
Alright, we're done
here. You earned a
training grade of ''^0000FFA^000000.''
You're really good at this!
scripts.translation:
[基恩娜]
好，训练结束，成绩是^0000FFA^000000。
很有本事嘛！

scripts.text:
[Kienna]
Alright, we're done
here. You earned a
training grade of ''^0000FFB +^000000.''
That's very commendable!
scripts.translation:
[基恩娜]
好，训练结束，成绩是^0000FFB +^000000。
值得表扬！

scripts.text:
[Kienna]
Alright, we're done
here. You earned a
training grade of ''^0000FFB^000000.''
That's very nice work~
scripts.translation:
[基恩娜]
好，训练结束，成绩是^0000FFB^000000。
干得不错~

scripts.text:
[Kienna]
Alright, we're done
here. You earned a
training grade of ''^0000FFC +^000000.''
Not too bad, but you
just barely passed!
scripts.translation:
[基恩娜]
好，训练结束，成绩是^0000FFC +^000000。
不算太差，不过也只是勉强及格！

scripts.text:
[Kienna]
Alright, we're done
here. You earned a
training grade of ''^FF0000C^000000.''
scripts.translation:
[基恩娜]
好，训练结束，成绩是^FF0000C^000000。

scripts.text:
[Kienna]
Alright, we're done
here. You earned a
training grade of ''^FF0000D+^000000.''
scripts.translation:
[基恩娜]
好，训练结束，成绩是^FF0000D+^000000。

scripts.text:
[Kienna]
Alright, we're done
here. You earned a
training grade of ''^FF0000D^000000.''
scripts.translation:
[基恩娜]
好，训练结束，成绩是^FF0000D^000000。

scripts.text:
[Kienna]
Alright, we're done
here. You earned a
training grade of ''^FF0000F^000000.''
scripts.translation:
[基恩娜]
好，训练结束，成绩是^FF0000F^000000。

scripts.text:
[Kienna]
Alright, we're done
here. You earned a
training grade of ''^FF0000F -^000000.''
scripts.translation:
[基恩娜]
好，训练结束，成绩是^FF0000F -^000000。

scripts.text:
[Kienna]
Alright, we're done
here. You earned a
training grade of...
Actually, I'm not able
to calculate it. What
could have happened?!
scripts.translation:
[基恩娜]
好，训练结束，成绩是...
咦，算不出来，究竟怎么回事？！

scripts.text:
[Kienna]
I'm happy to say that
you've completed your
training! Let me send
you back to Thor Greg
now so that you can finish
learning ^FF0000Close Confine^000000.
scripts.translation:
[基恩娜]
恭喜，训练完成了！
送你回索尔·格雷格那里，继续学完^FF0000紧密的约束^000000。

scripts.text:
[Kienna]
Hm. With this grade,
I don't think you're
quite ready to finish
learning Close Confine.
Would you like to try the
training exercise again?
scripts.translation:
[基恩娜]
嗯，这个成绩，恐怕还不够学完紧密的约束。
要再练一次吗？

scripts.text: Yes!
scripts.translation: 再试一次

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢

scripts.text:
[Kienna]
You must have canceled
your training in the middle
of the exercise. I'm sorry,
but you'll have to start
from the very beginning
of this training.
scripts.translation:
[基恩娜]
看来你中途取消了训练。
抱歉，得从头再来。

scripts.text:
[Kienna]
You've already completed
the training exercise for
the Close Confine skill.
You no longer have need
for my assistance.
scripts.translation:
[基恩娜]
紧密的约束的训练，你已完成，不用我再帮忙了。

scripts.text:
[Kienna]
I'm sorry, but I don't
